newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron leads in Philippine oil market.
newsitem.headline: Petron leads in Philippine oil market.

text.p: Philippine oil refiner Petron Corp has cornered the biggest market share at 41.7 percent of the Philippine oil market for the first seven months of the year, industry figures showed.

Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp, a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell Group, had 33.8 percent while Caltex (Philippines) Inc, a joint venture between US-based Chevron Corp and Texaco Inc, had the lowest share at 24.5 percent.
The total oil inland market of the three refiners amounted to 75.42 million barrels for the first seven months of the year, a 5.0 percent rise from last year's 71.85 million barrels.
Pilipinas Shell posted an increase in market share from last year's seven-month figure of 31.2 percent. Petron had a 42 percent market share in the same 1995 period while Caltex had 26.8 percent.
Pilipinas Shell led the production of gasoline for the first seven months of the year at 4.1 million barrels while Petron produced the largest volume of diesel at 9.25 million barrels.
Petron was also the biggest producer of white oils which include kerosene, liquefied petroleum gas and aviation turbo at 17.76 million barrels as well as fuel oil at 13.24 million barrels.
